# Lopez Cuts

> Lopez Cuts (also written Lopezcuts) is the barber business of Miguel Lopez in Salt Lake City, Utah. Miguel is from the DC/Virginia area (the DMV), is a student at the University of Utah, has cut hair since age 14 and has 250+ clients in Salt Lake City with a 5.0 rating (34 reviews on Booksy).

- Services: taper fades, burst fades, skin fades, modern and burst mullets, mod cuts, scissor cuts, lineups, curly hair, beards and designs.
- Prices: $25 first cut, $30 returning, +$5 beard or design, free touch-ups. Cuts take up to 40 minutes.
- Booking: online at https://www.lopezcuts.com/ (the exact address is sent privately with the booking confirmation).
